newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dah Bang in possible offer by Golik.
newsitem.headline: Dah Bang in possible offer by Golik.

text.p: Dah Bang (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday Golik Investments Ltd has agreed to buy 57.86 percent of Dah Bang's issued share capital and 72.49 percent of total warrants outstanding from its chairman Chen Da Yun and other directors for HK$107.77 million in cash.
Golik also planned a cash offer at HK$0.90 per share and HK$0.125 per warrant, same as the purchase price, subject to completion of the sales agreement, they said in a statement.
The Golik group is 91.34 percent held by businessman Pang Tak Chung and 8.66 percent by China Metallurgic (Hong Kong) Ltd, a unit of China Iron and Steel Industry and Trade Group Corp.
The purchase and offer price for the Dah Bang shares were the same as the price at the close on Thursday but at a 25 percent discount to the HK$0.167 close of the warrants.
Trading was suspended on Friday pending an announcement.
Chen and two Dah Bang directors, Chen Chung Man Shun and Paul Chen, would hold a total of 15 percent of the company's shares after the transaction, the statement said.
Golik had been granted a call option, exercisable from October 1, 1997 to December 31, 1997 to buy all remaining Dah Bang shares they held for HK$27 million, or HK$0.90 per share.
